{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA rows (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for LOYAL customers with completed status
loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print("Number of LOYAL completed orders after removing QA rows:", len(loyal_completed))
print("Mean revenue of LOYAL completed orders:", mean_revenue)"}
